assets_sizes.name: assets_sizes
assets_sizes.value: "assets"."bytes" > 0 AND "assets"."original_bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 10485760 AND length("assets"."alt") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length("assets"."filename") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("assets"."sha256") = 64

audit_log_json.name: audit_log_json
audit_log_json.value: ("audit_log"."actor_meta" IS NULL OR json_valid("audit_log"."actor_meta")) AND ("audit_log"."detail" IS NULL OR json_valid("audit_log"."detail"))

audit_log_sizes.name: audit_log_sizes
audit_log_sizes.value: length("audit_log"."action") <= 64 AND ("audit_log"."detail" IS NULL OR length("audit_log"."detail") <= 2000) AND ("audit_log"."actor_meta" IS NULL OR length("audit_log"."actor_meta") <= 2000)

entries_draft.name: entries_draft
entries_draft.value: "entries"."status" <> 'draft' OR ("entries"."published_rev" IS NULL AND "entries"."published_sort_key" IS NULL AND "entries"."scheduled_at" IS NULL)

entries_published.name: entries_published
entries_published.value: "entries"."status" <> 'published' OR ("entries"."published_rev" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "entries"."published_sort_key" IS NOT NULL)

publications_shape.name: publications_shape
publications_shape.value: ("publications"."action" = 'publish' AND "publications"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "publications"."verdict" IS NOT NULL) OR ("publications"."action" = 'unpublish' AND "publications"."revision_id" IS NULL AND "publications"."verdict" IS NULL)

publications_json.name: publications_json
publications_json.value: json_valid("publications"."acknowledged") AND json_type("publications"."acknowledged") = 'array' AND ("publications"."verdict" IS NULL OR json_valid("publications"."verdict")) AND ("publications"."actor_meta" IS NULL OR json_valid("publications"."actor_meta"))

reviews_decided.name: reviews_decided
reviews_decided.value: ("reviews"."status" IN ('pending', 'cancelled')) OR ("reviews"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

reviews_json.name: reviews_json
reviews_json.value: json_valid("reviews"."acknowledged") AND json_type("reviews"."acknowledged") = 'array' AND ("reviews"."requested_meta" IS NULL OR json_valid("reviews"."requested_meta"))

revisions_json.name: revisions_json
revisions_json.value: json_valid("revisions"."frontmatter") AND json_valid("revisions"."document") AND json_valid("revisions"."verdict") AND ("revisions"."actor_meta" IS NULL OR json_valid("revisions"."actor_meta"))

schedules_json.name: schedules_json
schedules_json.value: json_valid("schedules"."acknowledged") AND json_type("schedules"."acknowledged") = 'array' AND ("schedules"."actor_meta" IS NULL OR json_valid("schedules"."actor_meta"))

site_changes_json.name: site_changes_json
site_changes_json.value: ("site_changes"."before" IS NULL OR json_valid("site_changes"."before")) AND ("site_changes"."after" IS NULL OR json_valid("site_changes"."after")) AND ("site_changes"."actor_meta" IS NULL OR json_valid("site_changes"."actor_meta"))
